scripts.dev: concurrently "bun run --cwd apps/api dev" "bun run --cwd apps/mock-swiggy dev" "bun run --cwd apps/web dev"
scripts.build:all: bun run typecheck && bun run test:unit && bun run check:maps && bun run build:web && echo 'build:all OK → apps/web/dist'
scripts.typecheck: bun ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && bun ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && bun ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p apps/mock-swiggy/tsconfig.json && bun ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && bun ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p packages/db/tsconfig.json && echo 'All typechecks pass'
scripts.ci:local: bun run test:unit && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web && bun run check:maps && gitleaks detect --no-banner
